info.title: LFen's Second Brain — C1/C3 foundation
info.description: Stage 1 A contract. Native authentication and dataset/document/file identities are reused. All registered domains are owner-only and catalogue-only. Keys, temporary sharing, semantic retrieval, parsing, graph edges and memory/persona are not implemented here. JSON bodies max 16 KiB; unknown fields, repeated/unknown queries and extra JSON values are rejected. Root group parent_id is null; list root children by omitting parent_id. Cursors are scope-bound pagination state, not credentials. Every page is reauthorized. Native middleware errors may keep native envelopes.

NativeSession.name: Authorization
NativeSession.description: Use the existing RAGFlow authenticated user session header verbatim; do not prepend Bearer unless required by your native deployment. This is not a temporary domain grant. Never distribute owner/provider keys.

x-knowledge-frozen.consistency: Writes within a domain serialize on its DB row; native object write precedes catalogue DB commit and can leave an unreferenced immutable blob after rollback. Lists are weakly consistent; exact revision content is immutable and hash-verified.

source_import.sequence: Create empty native dataset without embedding_model, register domain, then upload synthetic UTF-8 file and snapshot explicitly.
source_import.native_create_caution: Providing embedding_model to the native create endpoint can trigger its availability probe; omit that field for model-free foundation setup.
source_import.constraints: The registered-domain upload adapter preserves original filename/bytes, requires valid UTF-8 without NUL, and caps files at 2 MiB. No PDF/PPT/OCR, Git watching or automatic indexing in this contract.
source_import.revision_scope: Snapshots observe the native Document payload plus classification. File editor changes and external file changes are not automatically synchronized. A future incremental producer must reuse Document.ID for the same logical source.

x-knowledge-frozen.domain_registration: Requires an empty private dataset without Connector links or ingestion history. Existing registered domains replay idempotently for the same category.
x-knowledge-frozen.native_model_settings: Registered domains reject embd_id/embedding_model updates before native availability probes; native creation before registration must omit embedding_model.
